view: Qin Xianyang palace archaeological platform, close oblique excavation study of low rammed-earth foundation with horizontal compacted layers, recessed room floor and a few broken grey ceramic roof tiles, flat Wei valley distant. No standing Chinese palace, no pagoda, no terracotta warriors.

eras.title: What remains of a Qin palace
eras.caption: At Xianyang, raised foundations preserve the footprint of the Qin royal palaces. The timber buildings have gone, leaving earth, floor surfaces and architectural fragments to explain how the capital stood above the Wei River plain.
